description: This Java class 'UpdateInterestRateChartCommandHandler' is a Spring service that handles commands to update interest rate charts within the Fineract project. It implements a command handler interface, processes incoming commands, and delegates the actual update operation to the 'InterestRateChartWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: UpdateInterestRateChartCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles updating interest rate charts by processing commands and delegating the update operation to the write platform service.

methods.name: UpdateInterestRateChartCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the InterestRateChartWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JsonCommand to update an interest rate chart by calling the write platform service's update method.
